name: theme-switch
title: Theme switch
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Four ways to move between light and dark: fade, eclipse, split, and rise. Uses the View Transitions API when the browser has it, and changes the theme immediately otherwise. The default icon stays the lucide sun and moon. icon can be one of the theme-toggle-icons.

meta.descriptionEs: Cuatro formas de pasar de claro a oscuro: fade, eclipse, split y rise. Usa View Transitions si el navegador las tiene y, si no, cambia el tema al instante.

examples.title: Interruptor de tema
examples.description: Cuatro formas de pasar de claro a oscuro: fade, eclipse, split y rise. Usa View Transitions si el navegador las tiene y, si no, cambia el tema al instante.

api.name: theme
api.description: The theme that is showing now.

api.name: variant
api.description: How the next theme enters. Default fade.

api.name: onThemeChange
api.description: Next-themes compatible. Receives the next theme.

api.name: iconOnly / label / className / classNames
api.description: Icon-only control, accessible label, and slot classes.

api.name: icon
api.description: Default lucide. Any theme-toggle-icons name renders that icon and shares the variant duration.

docs: Adapted from Arc UI (MIT). Optional icons come from theme-toggle-icons (MIT, Alfie Jones). Durations stay in sync: fade 280ms, eclipse 520ms, split 480ms, rise 480ms. The default icon remains lucide. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors. Motion is skipped when the reader prefers reduced motion.
